g.text: Missing grid positions and sample density answer different questions
11 March 2011 · same UTC day; valid off-grid samples enter density only.
Blank raw values are not zero. Missingness status is not a causal explanation.
Source: NOAA CO-OPS, recovered NOAA Saipan archive, IOC sea-level observations; accepted local cache (2026-10-05 audit).
Tōhoku 2011 · USGS origin 2011-03-11T05:46:24.120Z · descriptive coverage only, not onset. UTC windows; no map projection.
Original source minute grid; no interpolation or timestamp snapping. Black ticks in time strips: off-grid samples, never gap repair.
